Latest inflation data just dropped. And... prices are still rising at an uncomfortably high rate.

Headline inflation was 3.4% over the past year. This month, prices grew by 0.4%. This is pretty much as expected, but no-one was expecting good news.

posts.text: A government check that only spends on American goods is a subsidy contingent on domestic over imported purchases. WTO rules explicitly ban that. So Trump's $5,000 idea is either a slogan with no real content, or a policy that invites a fresh round of retaliatory tariffs.
